summary: Preinstall script fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (hex-suffixed identifiers, property-indirection maps hiding literal arguments) and downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases to a temporary directory, extracts it, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727 KB heavily obfuscated blob at the package root (obfuscator.io-style rotating string-array with a shift routine and array decoder, emitted with a `// @bun @bun-cjs` Bun-bytecode header). The blob is not part of dist/ or src/ and is invoked exclusively by the preinstall script under the fetched Bun runtime, placing execution outside the visibility of Node-based tooling. The behavior is inconsistent with the package's stated micro-frontend loader purpose; a legitimate MFE loader has no reason to ship an obfuscated Bun-compiled payload and execute it via a downloaded alternate runtime during npm install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
